edge_thesis: The common mechanism is a narrowing US rate differential plus falling real rates: I want duration-like convexity (gold), the unwind of the dollar carry trade (short USDJPY into BOJ normalization/Fed easing), and the earnings-revision leg of AI capex (NVDA), with BTC as a small high-beta liquidity expression. The other side is carry-funded dollar longs, gold profit-takers, valuation-anchored semis shorts, and leveraged perp longs — all of whom are structurally forced to cover on the same catalysts (soft US data, BOJ hikes, hyperscaler capex guides), which is why I expect the move to arrive fast rather than grind. Stops are set outside one daily sigma but inside my price-anchor confidence band so a bad fill assumptions kills the pick cheaply instead of bleeding it.

picks.why: BOJ hiking into Fed cuts compresses the differential; carry longs are the trapped other side.
Real-rate decline plus central-bank bid; zero-coupon convexity with a 2.25% risk band.
Blackwell/Rubin ramp and hyperscaler capex revisions vs valuation shorts who must cover.
Spot-ETF creations plus supply squeeze; sized small because leveraged longs can flush first.
Zero-fee total-market NAV accrual as the no-stop, USD-scored ballast per fund rule.
